describes: Grey gathered stone, gneiss and granite boulders split or laid as found, the plinths of the timber houses, set in lime mortar and left their own colour.

notes.srgb: The mean stone as a screen colour, judged by look; each stone differs by its seed up to valueSpread in value and warmSpread towards warm or cool (a wall of one colour reads as one band, R2b's strict review; 0.16 read as a patchwork at the street stop, the houses' round 3). Plinths kept their own material colour (the research).
notes.water: Its water profile as the town's (Shaders/Water.hlsl): near the town's granite (LT1Stone: 0.45, 0.9, 0.1, 0.3), a fieldstone's weathered, rougher face darkening a little more and glazing less. Judged by look.
